title: Rethinking Evaluation Metric for Probability Estimation Models Using Esports Data
reasoning: The paper focuses on proposing and evaluating technical metrics (Brier score, ECE, Balance score) for probability estimation models in esports. It does not discuss religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics. The mention of 'bias' refers to a statistical bias in the ECE metric due to binning, not a societal or ethical bias of a model.
